Definition: {a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance)}
BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word for brother occurs once, in Ezra 7:18, in the king's letter to Ezra: 'whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.' It names Ezra's fellow workers — the brethren who share his charge over the temple funds.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse, one word — ‘thy brethren’ — and it is about shared stewardship, which is how God’s work is meant to be carried: together, by brethren, according to the will of God.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
